claim: The earlier pass line is withdrawn. E2 (rpt-sciences-g6-review-e2-admission-limits-1022) is a scoped arithmetic check. Stress was inverted from the owner's margins. Thermal was scaled from the owner's baseline. Growth and joining were unchecked. Closure roots were not independently optimized. Direct film DOI validation was not demonstrated. The join modulus is corrected to 069's 293.6 GPa; 290 GPa is rejected. The join that 069's float survives is rejected: 073's equibiaxial result supersedes it. Twenty-eight load-bearing numbers were re-derived and the owner code was not run. That re-derivation is not an absence of mismatch. Unity knockdown at Vc at or above 2 stays admissible only with the named limit that it is not this film on CR-III and not a closed 20 to 30 m sphere. Five NFI rows remain.
qualification: No installed hull safety factor is released. QUESTIONABLE inputs. PROJECTION targets. The broad pass is withdrawn by DELTA-E2-1022. E2 is a scoped arithmetic check, not an absence of mismatch.
